sample_adjustments.reason: The original ray was exactly on the open end edge of the first stair mesh and hit lower terrain while its capsule overlapped the first riser. This moves the clearance sample 0.915 m to the centre of the actual first tread (Blender x=-92.2083, y=-44.5417, authored tread top=11.9407 m). A separate physical threshold route retains the original endpoint to verify actual access.
